definitions.explanation: the 17 global goals adopted by the United Nations in 2015 to address poverty, inequality, climate change, and other challenges by 2030; widely recognized and promoted in Japan

examples.japanese: SDGs⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{意識|いしき}した→意識する：17974_ishikisuru⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧です。
examples.english: This is a product designed with the SDGs in mind.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧SDGs⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{積極|せっきょく}{的|てき}→積極的：01585_sekkyokuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}んでいる→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
examples.english: This company is actively working on the SDGs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧SDGs⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: I learned about the SDGs at school.

notes:
THE 17 GOALS:
The SDGs cover 17 areas including:
1. ⟦{貧困|ひんこん}→貧困：04836_hinkon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧なくそう (No Poverty)
2. ⟦{飢餓|きが}→飢餓：18841_kiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ゼロ→ゼロ：01011_zero⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (Zero Hunger)
3. すべて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{福祉|ふくし}→福祉：13748_fukushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ (Good Health and Well-being)
4. ⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (Quality Education)
13. ⟦{気候|きこう}{変動|へんどう}→気候変動：04627_kikouhendou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{具体|ぐたい}{的|てき}→具体的：04781_gutaiteki⟧な⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ (Climate Action)

CULTURAL NOTE:
SDGs awareness is high in Japan. Many companies display the SDGs badge on their websites and products. Schools include SDGs in their curriculum.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- SDGs⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧ - to work on the SDGs
- SDGs⟦{達成|たっせい}→達成：04816_tassei⟧ - achieving the SDGs
- SDGsバッジ - SDGs pin/badge
